data.answer:
**Possibly, but the evidence is not conclusive.** The 2020 Australian IP Report says ICT-related design applications filed in Australia fell sharply in 2009, which “may reflect the impact of the global financial crisis”—a qualified explanation, not an established causal finding.[1]

This category covers technology gadgets such as mobile phones and laptop computers.[2] Applications recovered quickly after 2009, trebling to 746 in 2013. The report also notes recurring steep growth and large declines, especially after 2005, so the crisis-related fall occurred within an already volatile filing pattern.[3]
